subject.title: [Feature]: Discord - auto-inject @mention for guild message replies

question: Should the Discord plugin add a default-off `autoMentionReply` policy that visibly mentions the original guild message author on replies, or should native Discord replies plus explicit/alias mentions remain the supported notification behavior?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested fix adds notification policy and config surface in an M4 Discord channel, so automation should not choose the product default or mention semantics alone.

options.title: Approve opt-in auto-mention policy
options.body: Add a default-off Discord plugin config with author-ID prefixing, duplicate-mention and broadcast safety checks, docs, focused tests, and live guild proof.

options.title: Keep current notification model
options.body: Leave native Discord replies and explicit or alias mentions as the supported behavior, then close this direction as not planned with docs clarifying the boundary.

options.title: Require live proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open but require a live multi-bot Discord reproduction and expected notification transcript before accepting new config surface.

recommendation.title: Approve opt-in auto-mention policy
recommendation.body: Add a default-off Discord plugin config with author-ID prefixing, duplicate-mention and broadcast safety checks, docs, focused tests, and live guild proof.
